opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled on an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution, not eligible for other tuition fee support, resident in Scotland, from low‑income households, and meeting residency and immigration criteria.
opportunities.summary: Provides tuition fee support of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students studying at Scottish universities or colleges.
